change: Construction-time local metric normalization and a shared direct rewrite dispatcher with a no-op visitor guard replace repeated wildcard matching and unnecessary reconstruction.
baseline: Shared metric/vector contractor and optimized epsilon cleanup from gamma_cleanup.json.
timing_method: Five warm samples per method; rotating method order, adaptive batches targeting 8ms, output destruction included. CPU 6 on a shared host. API methods exclude parsing/construction; parse_only and parse_and_normalize_dots use identical recorded source text and include parsing/construction. Same expanded driver links saved baseline libraries before the change and optimized current libraries afterward. FORM measured separately on CPU 3.

methodology.wall: One warmup process, then three measured processes. Six batches per process; entire wall time divided by total traces. Includes process startup, parsing/input normalization, trace4, sorting, count printing, drop and shutdown. Polynomial printing and exact checks excluded.
methodology.cpu: FORM internal timer covers trace4 plus .sort after input preparation; median last five of six batches, divided by traces per batch; median across three measured processes. Millisecond timer resolution applies per batch.
methodology.counts: Generated terms count StoreTerm submissions to sorter; sorted terms count final monomials after trace4+.sort. Neither is peak resident terms. Separate untimed run writes normalized input and complete polynomial. This artifact reuses that earlier untimed run; fresh timing processes also check the expected sorted-term count in every batch.
methodology.scope: Independent p_i vectors and explicit4D Lorentz indices a,b,c,d,mu_i. No numeric/on-shell specialization. FORM fully normalizes external metrics before trace4. Idenso input construction is excluded from its timer; amortized FORM wall includes parsing/input preparation.
methodology.host: Shared host; CPU3 affinity inherited by child processes. Results are measurements, not a claim of equivalence based on term counts.

validation.scope: Seven reductions subtract to symboliczero in FORM. Two gamma5 reductions leave Schouten combinations after sorting; all nine original and reduced traces agree at three exact integer4D vector assignments with nonzero original values. These are within-FORM checks, not cross-library tensor-network validation.

provenance.timings: Fresh FORM measurements for this cleanup comparison; one warmup and three measured processes per case.
provenance.counts_and_validation: Untimed counts and exact symbolic/component validation were reused, not rerun. Identical inputs, FORM executable, programs and count-log hashes were checked against the previous record.

reproduction_sources.measure.py:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re,statistics,subprocess,time
ROOT=Path(__file__).parent
INPUTS=json.load(open(ROOT/'inputs.json'))
FORM=INPUTS['form_executable']
REPETITIONS={'order_sensitive_12':600,'external_metrics_12':600,'ordinary_odd_8':3000,'ordinary_even2_8':5000,'ordinary_even4_10':400,'ordinary_cyclic_12':150,'axial_odd_8':3000,'axial_even4_10':1000,'axial_crossing_12':1500,'free_8':600,'free_12':40,'axial_12':150}
records=[]
for case in INPUTS['cases']:
    n=REPETITIONS[case['case']]
    program='Off Statistics;\n'+INPUTS['header']+f"""#do batch=1,6
#do j=1,{n}
Local F`j'={case['expression']};
#enddo
.sort
#reset timer
trace4,1;
.sort
#write "BATCH_CPU_MS=`timer_'"
#$n=termsin_(F1);
#write "TERMS=%$",$n
Drop;
.sort
#enddo
.end
"""
    path=ROOT/f"{case['case']}-timing.frm";path.write_text(program)
    wall=[];cpu=[];raw_cpu=[];raw_logs=[]
    for sample in range(4):
        started=time.perf_counter_ns()
        p=subprocess.run([FORM,'-q',str(path)],cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
        elapsed=(time.perf_counter_ns()-started)/(n*6)
        path.with_suffix(f'.{sample}.log').write_text(p.stdout)
        raw_logs.append(p.stdout)
        times=list(map(int,re.findall(r'BATCH_CPU_MS=(\d+)',p.stdout)))
        counts=list(map(int,re.findall(r'TERMS=(\d+)',p.stdout)))
        assert len(times)==6 and counts==[case['sorted_terms']]*6,(times,counts)
        if sample:
            wall.append(elapsed);cpu.append(statistics.median(times[1:])*1e6/n);raw_cpu.append(times)
    record=dict(case=case['case'],idenso_case='free_trace_8'if case['case']=='free_8'else case['case'],expression=case['expression'],normalized_input=case['normalized_input'],generated_terms=case['generated_terms'],sorted_terms=case['sorted_terms'],traces_per_batch=n,batches_per_process=6,wall_ns_samples=wall,wall_ns_median=statistics.median(wall),cpu_ns_samples=cpu,cpu_ns_median=statistics.median(cpu),raw_batch_cpu_ms=raw_cpu,timing_program=program,raw_timing_output=raw_logs,counts_program=case['counts_program'],counts_output=(ROOT/f"{case['case']}-counts.log").read_text())
    records.append(record)
    summary=dict(schema_version=1,date='2026-09-24',form_executable=FORM,form_version=INPUTS['version'],form_executable_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(FORM).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),source_url='https://github.com/form-dev/form/blob/v5.0.0/sources/opera.c',source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path('/tmp/trace-intermediate-form/form-5.0.0/sources/opera.c').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),cpu=3,methodology=dict(wall='One warmup process, then three measured processes. import difflib, hashlib, json, math, statistics, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
ROOT = Path('/tmp/dot-normalization-improvements')
REPO = Path('/common/dev/gammaloop/feynkit-rich-display')
TARGET = REPO / 'examples/notebooks/dot_normalization.json'
OLD_FORM = Path('/tmp/gamma-cleanup-improvements/form/compact_summary.json')
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def json_file(p): return json.loads(p.read_text())
def json_lines(p): return [json.loads(x) for x in p.read_text().splitlines() if x.strip()]
def identity(p): return dict(path=str(p), sha256=sha(p), bytes=p.stat().st_size)
def check_median(samples, median):
    assert samples and all(math.isfinite(v) and v > 0 for v in samples)
    assert math.isclose(statistics.median(samples), median, rel_tol=1e-12)

def compact_form():
    directory = ROOT / 'form'
    fresh = json_file(directory / 'summary.json')
    inputs = json_file(directory / 'inputs.json')
    cached = json_file(OLD_FORM)
    old_cases = {row['case']: row for row in cached['records']}
    input_cases = {row['case']: row for row in inputs['cases']}
    result = {key: value for key, value in fresh.items() if key not in ['records', 'validation']}
    result['records'] = []
    assert len(fresh['records']) == len(input_cases) == 12
    assert fresh['form_executable_sha256'] == cached['form_executable_sha256']
    for record in fresh['records']:
        case = record['case']
        old, source = old_cases[case], input_cases[case]
        for key in ['expression', 'normalized_input', 'generated_terms', 'sorted_terms', 'counts_program']:
            assert record[key] == old[key] == source[key], (case, key)
        count_path = directory / f'{case}-counts.log'
        assert sha(count_path) == source['counts_log_sha256'] == old['counts_output_sha256']
        assert count_path.read_text() == record['counts_output']
        program_path = directory / f'{case}-timing.frm'
        assert program_path.read_text() == record['timing_program']
        for metric in ['wall', 'cpu']:
            check_median(record[f'{metric}_ns_samples'], record[f'{metric}_ns_median'])
        logs = [directory / f'{case}-timing.{sample}.log' for sample in range(4)]
        assert [path.read_text() for path in logs] == record['raw_timing_output']
        compact = {key: value for key, value in record.items() if key != 'counts_output'}
        compact.update(
            timing_program_sha256=sha(program_path),
            counts_output_sha256=sha(count_path),
            raw_timing_log_sha256=[sha(path) for path in logs],
            counts_provenance='Reused untimed count run; SHA-256 matches the prior trace-order record.',
        )
        result['records'].append(compact)
    validation = json_file(directory / 'validation.json')
    assert validation == fresh['validation']
    for key in ['symbolic_zero_cases', 'noncanonical_epsilon_residual_cases', 'symbolic_program']:
        assert validation[key] == cached['validation'][key], key
    for current, previous in zip(validation['component_checks'], cached['validation']['component_checks'], strict=True):
        for key in ['seed', 'vectors', 'program', 'original_nonzero_values']:
            assert current[key] == previous[key], key
    result['validation'] = validation
    result['provenance'] = {
        'timings': 'Fresh FORM measurements for this cleanup comparison; one warmup and three measured processes per case.',
        'counts_and_validation': 'Untimed counts and exact symbolic/component validation were reused, not rerun. Identical inputs, FORM executable, programs and count-log hashes were checked against the previous record.',
        'reused_record': identity(OLD_FORM),
        'fresh_summary': identity(directory / 'summary.json'),
        'inputs': identity(directory / 'inputs.json'),
        'validation': identity(directory / 'validation.json'),
    }
    result['methodology']['counts'] += ' This artifact reuses that earlier untimed run; fresh timing processes also check the expected sorted-term count in every batch.'
    result['reproduction_sources'] = {
        'measure.py': (directory / 'measure.py').read_text(),
        'inputs.json': inputs,
    }
    (directory / 'compact_summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
    return result

def main():
    phases = {p: json_lines(ROOT / f'{p}.jsonl') for p in ['before', 'after']}
    keyed = {p: {(r['case'], r['method']): r for r in rows} for p, rows in phases.items()}
    assert len(keyed['before']) == len(keyed['after']) == 641
    assert keyed['before'].keys() == keyed['after'].keys()
    for rows in phases.values():
        for r in rows:
            check_median(r['samples_ns'], r['median_ns'])
    snapshots = {phase: {p.name: sha(p) for p in sorted((ROOT / f'{phase}-output').iterdir())}
                 for phase in phases}
    assert snapshots['before'].keys() == snapshots['after'].keys()
    differences = []
    for name, old_hash in snapshots['before'].items():
        if old_hash == snapshots['after'][name]:
            continue
        row = {'name': name, 'before_sha256': old_hash, 'after_sha256': snapshots['after'][name]}
        for phase in phases:
            p = ROOT / f'{phase}-output' / name
            if p.stat().st_size < 10000:
                row[phase] = p.read_text()
        differences.append(row)
    assert not [r for r in differences if r['name'].endswith('.source')], 'source inputs changed'
    form = compact_form()
    form_cases = {r['idenso_case']: r for r in form['records']}
    comparisons = []
    for key, before in keyed['before'].items():
        after = keyed['after'][key]
        case, method = key
        out_name = f'{case}.{method}.output'
        row = dict(case=case, method=method, before_ms=before['median_ns']/1e6,
                   after_ms=after['median_ns']/1e6,
                   speedup=before['median_ns']/after['median_ns'],
                   output_identical=snapshots['before'][out_name] == snapshots['after'][out_name])
        if method == 'full_gamma' and case in form_cases:
            row.update(form_wall_ms=form_cases[case]['wall_ns_median']/1e6,
                       after_over_form=after['median_ns']/form_cases[case]['wall_ns_median'])
        comparisons.append(row)
    before_hashes = json_file(ROOT / 'baseline-source-sha256.json')
    for name, digest in before_hashes.items():
        assert sha(ROOT / 'baseline-source' / name) == digest
    changed = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', '--', 'crates/idenso',
                                      'crates/spenso', 'crates/spenso-hep-lib'], cwd=REPO, text=True).splitlines()
    new = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '--',
                                  'crates/idenso', 'crates/spenso', 'crates/spenso-hep-lib'],
                                 cwd=REPO, text=True).splitlines()
    sources = sorted(set(before_hashes) | {p for p in changed + new if p.endswith('.rs')})
    after_hashes = {p: sha(REPO/p) for p in sources if (REPO/p).is_file()}
    patches = {}
    for name in after_hashes:
        old = ROOT/'baseline-source'/name
        old_text = old.read_text() if old.exists() else ''
        patch = ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(old_text.splitlines(keepends=True),
                    (REPO/name).read_text().splitlines(keepends=True),
                    fromfile='before/'+name, tofile='after/'+name))
        if patch:
            patches[name] = patch
    measured = json_file(ROOT / 'measured-source-sha256.json')
    assert all(after_hashes[name] == digest for name, digest in measured.items()), 'Measured sources changed'
    validation = {}
    for name in ['idenso-tests', 'spenso-tests', 'hep-tests', 'clippy-idenso', 'clippy-spenso', 'clippy-hep']:
        p = ROOT/f'{name}.log'
        if p.exists():
            validation[name] = {**identity(p), 'summary': [l for l in p.read_text().splitlines()
                if any(s in l for s in ['Summary', 'Finished', 'FAIL [', 'error:', 'Nextest run ID'])]}
    record = dict(schema_version=1, date='2026-09-24',
        change='Construction-time local metric normalization and a shared direct rewrite dispatcher with a no-op visitor guard replace repeated wildcard matching and unnecessary reconstruction.',
        baseline='Shared metric/vector contractor and optimized epsilon cleanup from gamma_cleanup.json.',
        timing_method='Five warm samples per method; rotating method order, adaptive batches targeting 8ms, output destruction included. CPU 6 on a shared host. API methods exclude parsing/construction; parse_only and parse_and_normalize_dots use identical recorded source text and include parsing/construction. Same expanded driver links saved baseline libraries before the change and optimized current libraries afterward. FORM measured separately on CPU 3.',
        baseline_git=json_file(ROOT/'baseline-git.json'),
        preceding_records={name: identity(REPO / 'examples/notebooks' / name) for name in ['gamma_cleanup.json', 'metric_contraction.json']},
        before_source_sha256=before_hashes, after_source_sha256=after_hashes,
        measured_source_sha256=measured,
        baseline_libraries=json_file(ROOT/'baseline-libraries.json'),
        before_build_command=json_file(ROOT/'before-build-command.json'),
        before_build_environment={'CARGO_CRATE_NAME':'metric_contraction_benchmark'},
        before_driver=(ROOT/'before.rs').read_text(),
        executable_identities={p: identity(ROOT/p) for p in phases if (ROOT/p).exists()},
        benchmark_source='crates/idenso/examples/metric_contraction_benchmark.rs',
        benchmark_source_text=(REPO/'crates/idenso/examples/metric_contraction_benchmark.rs').read_text(),
        reproduction='taskset -c 6 cargo run --offline -p idenso --profile dev-optim --example metric_contraction_benchmark -- /tmp/dot-normalization-benchmark 5 8',
        matrix=dict(cases=len({k[0] for k in keyed['before']}), rows_per_phase=641, samples_per_row=5, form_cases=12),
        before=phases['before'], after=phases['after'], comparison=comparisons,
        gamma_comparison=[r for r in comparisons if r['method']=='full_gamma'], form=form,
        output_sha256=snapshots, snapshot_differences=differences,
        snapshot_summary=dict(total=len(snapshots['before']), different=len(differences),
                              identical=len(snapshots['before'])-len(differences)),
        snapshot_scope='Source text must match. Constructed inputs can differ because g now normalizes eagerly. Scalar trace powers intentionally change from stage-order-dependent D to compositional powers of D. Canonical restrictions reject legacy append-slot and dimension-mismatched vector forms. Differing output forms need semantic classification and independent HEP checks; counts alone are not equality evidence.',
        source_patches=patches, validation=validation,
        validation_summary={'passed':632, 'preexisting_failures':2, 'skipped':23, 'clippy':'All three scoped commands passed with -D warnings.', 'output_parity':'The final visitor implementation reproduces all 787 initial optimized snapshots byte for byte. All 16 full_gamma outputs also match the original baseline byte for byte.'},
        known_preexisting_limitations=[
            {'test':'idenso::tensor::tests::parsing::parse_scalar_tensors_step_by','kind':'Known snapshot mismatch; baseline gamma_cleanup.json.'},
            {'test':'spenso::network::parsing::structure_inference::tests::tensorial_syntax_recognizes_dual_representation_wrappers','kind':'Previously recorded dual-wrapper test failure; baseline metric_contraction.json.'},
            {'test':'spenso-hep-lib::metric_contraction_validation::tagged_vector_dots_preserve_dual_slot_orientation','kind':'Known compact dual-dot variance loss, explicitly ignored. Baseline evidence gamma_cleanup.json.'}],
        artifacts_directory=str(ROOT), aggregation_script=Path(__file__).read_text())
    record['initial_implementation'] = {
        'description': 'Before adding the no-op visitor guard; same eager metric callback and direct rewrite rules.',
        'measurements': json_lines(ROOT / 'initial-after.jsonl'),
        'executable': identity(ROOT / 'initial-after'),
        'source_sha256': json_file(ROOT / 'initial-measured-source-sha256.json'),
        'normalizer_source': (ROOT / 'initial-normalize_dots.rs').read_text(),
        'source_identity_note': 'Initial source hashes precede final test-only fixes in metric constructor tests; the original production implementation is retained in the profiler sources.',
        'profile': json_file(ROOT / 'initial-profile.json'),
    }
    for name in ['final-runs.json', 'semantic-differences.json', 'profile.json', 'visitor-guard.json']:
        if (ROOT/name).exists():
            record[name.removesuffix('.json').replace('-','_')] = json_file(ROOT/name)
    TARGET.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2)+'\n')
    print('Wrote', TARGET, record['matrix'], record['snapshot_summary'])
    for r in record['gamma_comparison']:
        print(r['case'], round(r['before_ms'],5), round(r['after_ms'],5), round(r['speedup'],2), r.get('form_wall_ms'))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

# Residual cleanup after direct dot normalization

This temporary standalone driver reads the saved terminal axial6/8/10/12 outputs from `../before-output`. Parsing and validation are excluded from timing. Every Atom-producing method must exactly preserve each expression; epsilon candidate checks must report no rewrite. Copied full dots and epsilon routines must agree with linked production. Five rotating rounds on CPU7 target 10ms per batch; destruction is timed.

`Dots` measures the full public normalizer; `CopiedDots` checks the same implementation copied without unit tests. The removed global metric stages have no equivalent after-stage and are omitted. Other methods cover epsilon candidates/full cleanup, repeated explicit indices, brackets, Schoonschip, chainify, chain collection, and full gamma simplification **of the already-evaluated output**. All 280 raw samples are retained. Independent timings are attribution estimates, not an exact whole-call decomposition.

`prepare.py` copies current production bracket, epsilon and dots sources and hashes them. Epsilon wrappers expose only the existing presence check and candidate walk. `build-command.json` is the exact standalone rustc argument array (run with `CARGO_CRATE_NAME=cleanup_phases`). Compile only after the parent build has completed. Then run the executable with `taskset -c 7 driver 5`, saving stdout as `raw.jsonl`, and run `summarize.py` to produce summary and manifest.

The primary matched before/after benchmark lives one directory above. Summary comparisons against the previous phase experiment are secondary: they were collected in separate process runs. No production files are changed by this driver.

methodology.validation: Every copied and guarded result equals linked production. Candidate truth equals whether production changes each parsed input. All assertions passed.
methodology.guard: Final production implementation uses one shared normalize_node dispatcher. A productive root returns its rewrite immediately; an opaque root returns its owned view. Successful below-root candidate computation is repeated in that traversal.
